current_prompt.body:
READ the composite feature request describing three features
SPLIT the request into three independent user stories
FOR each feature:
  IF the feature is a product search capability THEN
    CREATE a user story that describes a product search feature enabling a user to search for products by name
  ENDIF
  IF the feature is a dashboard element showing recent orders and recommending similar products THEN
    CREATE a user story that describes a dashboard element that shows the user's recent orders and recommends similar products based on the user's purchase history
  ENDIF
  IF the feature is a product detail view with inventory and reservation THEN
    CREATE a user story that describes a product detail view that displays real-time inventory levels across all warehouse locations and allows the user to reserve items for up to 24 hours
  ENDIF
OUTPUT the three user stories, each as a separate deliverable, preserving any explicit constraints such as the 24 hours reservation window

parsed.body:
User Story 1: As a user, I want to be able to search for products by name so that I can quickly find the items I am looking for.

User Story 2: As a user, I want a dashboard element that shows my recent orders and recommends similar products based on my purchase history, so that I can discover items I may be interested in.

User Story 3: As a user, I want a product detail view that displays real‑time inventory levels across all warehouse locations and allows me to reserve items for up to 24 hours, so that I can secure the product I intend to purchase.
